## Reference videos

- [Bayesian Statistics: What Are Priors?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=brt2J5VgAHs) — Academia Elevated, English. **watch first**. Watch the prior as a component of the model before any data; the video stops at single-component priors, so the lab's mixture-prior part you still have to work out yourself.
- [(ML 6.1) Maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kkhdIriddSI) — mathematicalmonk, English. Watch MAP as a point estimate drawn from the posterior; it supports the point-estimation half of the lab.
- [What is a conjugate prior?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aPNrhR0dFi8) — Ben Lambert, English. Watch conjugacy break when the prior is no longer in the same family as the likelihood; use it as a warning when the lab moves to mixture priors.
